propositions: Execute a one-time destructive reclaim (force-with-lease push) of the tickets branch to strip historical commits and reclaim 92% of repository size under strict quiescence conditions (zero active sessions, all MCP servers stopped, all workflows and timers disabled).

Before publication, verify epoch-mismatch refusal using the deployed review-bot runtime and the explicitly refreshed host binary against real temporary clones to prove the epoch guard prevents stale-writer resurrection.
After the force-with-lease push succeeds, assert that the old tip is not an ancestor of origin/tickets and that object growth is < 1 MB, confirming no resurrection occurred.
Post-enable, validate reconciliation via either a green reconcile-bridge.yml run or operator-approved signed CLI subprocess with zero Jira batch errors, silent_noop=[], and canary drift_total=0.
Land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit mapped from the commit-map; the landed value must equal the post-rewrite SHA with require_authenticated=false to avoid CI deadlock.
Verify rebar fsck is clean post-enable and that pre/post identity verification reports are identical (ignoring rewritten commit SHAs), confirming no ticket data corruption or event loss.
